name: GODZILLA ANGRY
about: The C example GODZILLA ANGRY rebuilt in blocks and made Elvira's Gappa Angry: 1000 playfield switch hits fill the RAGE meter (2000 the second time, 3000 the third) and light the Building; a chase through five places, each with its red shots and a lock, to BABY at the Building; how many balls are locked picks the multiball: RODAN'S NEST (2 balls), MECHAGODZILLA (3), GARUDA (4), FIRE RODAN (5) or SUPER MECHAGODZILLA (6, after BABY FOUND's super jackpot), each with its own clips, music, jackpot shots, multiplier, light shows and shakes.
lost: The RAGE meter counts every playfield switch hit (PAD-675), 1000 the first time (stretches of 150 to 250), where the C had 750 (100 to 200); it waits while another mode runs, where the C counted through them.

No points while the mode is not running: the C pays 1,000,000 (+500,000 a stretch) at each RAGE stretch's end; the blocks' Score only scores while the mode runs, so a stretch is a note, a roar and a light show only.

No ball save: the C gives a 5 s ball save at the start and keeps one running from the first lock, so a drain with locks sends the locked balls straight into the multiball. In blocks a drain ends the chase; the place, its locks, the jackpot and the super wait for the next start at the Building (as the C does for a drain with no lock).

No randomness: each multiball's JACKPOT starts on its kind's first shot, moves on to the next of its four as its clock runs out and back one when it is hit, where the C's BABY jumped to another of four shots at random.
The multiballs are this blocks version's own (Gappa Angry's kinds, PAD-658 round 2): the C has ONE ANGRY MULTIBALL of the locks + 1 balls, BABY on the ramps, Building and Big loop, x1 to x6.

A blocks mode holds 12 clips: each kind has its own start clip, and RODAN'S NEST, GARUDA and FIRE RODAN replay it behind the HUD at their jackpots (MECHAGODZILLA has the ray-at-Mechagodzilla clip, the 6-ball the red spiral ray); the four smaller kinds share the lost clip at their end (the 6-ball after BABY FOUND has won).
The ending's line says JACKPOTS and the count (the C said 2 BABY JACKPOTS  -  5 LOCKS); after the chase it says LOCKS KEPT FOR THE TRAIL and the count (the C named the place the trail waits at).
The ending's TOTAL is the runtime's (up 3 s, or until 9 s after the end behind a full-screen ending clip): the C kept it 10 s.

The instruction line names the place's red shots once one or two are left ("SHOOT THE BIG LOOP AND BUILDING") and says ANY LIT SHOT: 4 TO GO while three or more of KYOTO's or MAKUHARI's are, the place under the LOCKS counter, where the C names them all while they fit ("OSAKA: BIG LOOP, BUILDING"); a start on the trail says THE TRAIL AGAIN with its locks, not the place's name.
The SUPER is on the glass only once BABY is the shot (the right counter counts the place's red shots to the lock until then): the C showed it all through the chase.

The badge counts the place's clock in the chase and the JACKPOT's next move in the multiball, where the C hides it in the multiball; a place's clock with locks turns into the multiball with a second left, not at 0.
One display priority, 180, throughout: the C takes 190 (a wizard's) for the multiball.
Its own light shows replace the game's Insert chase and Ember fade that the C played on a Premium/LE (and its own on a Pro), so every title sees the same shows.
Not on Godzilla Pro 1.15 (the C ran there): that older build names no switch shots (the Mecha lane, a jackpot shot of four of the five multiballs) and has no shaker steps.
No tilt rule of its own: the C stops the meter after a tilt until the next ball; here the tilted ball's shots still count.
Another mode of ours ending on the Building does not keep it from starting this one on that same shot (the C waits 300 ms after another of ours ends).
A start on the trail after a drain costs no meter (the Building stays lit until the multiball is played), as in the C; only the meter itself grows each time it is spent.

intro.what: Kyoto: Godzilla faces the camera head and shoulders and roars as debris flies, then black smoke billows up around him (0:47:20.8 to 0:47:25.8, one shot).

loop.what: Kyoto: wide shot of Godzilla advancing behind a five-story pagoda past a temple, onlookers in the foreground, small explosions and a helicopter at right (0:44:39.0 to 0:44:54.0, one continuous shot).

lock.what: Kyoto: Godzilla roars over the top of a white office block, then tears through it in a burst of debris (0:48:19.4 to 0:48:22.9, a run of two shots).

baby.what: Baby Godzilla in his pen at the research facility cries out with his mouth wide open, then turns to the people at the bars (1:00:13.7 to 1:00:18.2, one shot).

jackpot.what: First battle: Godzilla fires his blue atomic ray, then from behind him the ray strikes Mechagodzilla in a red burst (0:37:03.6 to 0:37:06.8, a run of two shots).

super.what: Climax at Makuhari: Godzilla glows and fires his red spiral ray, the ray streaks across, and Super Mechagodzilla is engulfed in a huge fireball (1:35:26.8 to 1:35:31.1, a run of three shots).

won.what: Ending: wide night shot of Godzilla wading out to sea with Baby swimming beside him while three people watch from the beach (1:44:52.0 to 1:44:58.0, one shot).

lost.what: First battle: Godzilla lies felled in the smoke, then Mechagodzilla hovers over his fallen body (0:38:30.5 to 0:38:35.4, a run of two shots).

mb2.what: Rodan flies in over the dusk sea off Adonoa Island, wings spread, and dives at the camera until his crested head fills the frame, 0:14:11.

mb3.what: Mechagodzilla lands in a blaze of backlight and rises into full view as it squares up to Godzilla for their first battle, 0:35:31.

mb4.what: The Garuda gunship lifts off its launch pad in the G-Force hangar on orange jets and billowing smoke, 1:09:59.

mb5.what: Fire Rodan, glowing red, glides through white smoke and dives on Super Mechagodzilla over the burning city, 1:32:40.

music.what: Opening titles: Akira Ifukube's main title music, rhythmic orchestral brass chords with cymbal and percussion, no dialogue or effects (0:03:30.15 to 0:03:43.40, loops cleanly).

rage.what: Revived Godzilla gives a short isolated roar in close-up at Makuhari (1:40:43.3), silence before and after.

angry.what: Revived Godzilla, a silhouette in fire and smoke, lets out a long full roar out of near silence (1:40:13.2).

lock.what: Outside Kyoto a shell explodes in the smoke around Godzilla, one heavy blast that decays to quiet (0:44:35.4).

baby.what: Newly hatched Baby Godzilla gives a short cry in the dark lab (0:27:35.4), silence before and after.

jackpot.what: Godzilla's atomic ray fires at Mechagodzilla, a rushing blast that swells and falls back, score underneath (0:37:03.9).

super.what: Super Mechagodzilla's salvo fires over burning Makuhari, a huge blast out of silence that rolls off (1:26:34.5).

won.what: Godzilla calls out to Baby at their night reunion by the bay, soft score underneath (1:42:47.6).

lost.what: Godzilla, felled by Mechagodzilla, gives a low pained cry from the ground in the smoke (0:38:31.8).

mb2.what: Rodan gives a long rising screech as it circles over the expedition at night on Adonoa Island, 0:13:27.

mb3.what: Mechagodzilla's thrusters roar as it lifts off from its launch tower, 0:33:35.

mb4.what: The Garuda's jets whoosh past the camera as the gunship flies in low and away, 1:10:19.

mb5.what: Fire Rodan gives his long cry as his head rises from the rubble when he is reborn, 1:32:06.

jp2.what: A short Rodan screech as Fire Rodan swoops past the camera over the city at night, 1:11:19.

jp4.what: The Garuda's twin maser cannons crackle as their blue beams fire over the city at night, 1:14:27.

jp5.what: A beam blast bursts into sparks around Fire Rodan as Super Mechagodzilla fires on him, 1:32:36.

mb2.what: Ifukube's Adonoa Island battle music swells as Godzilla's dorsal plates rise behind the rocks to fight Rodan, 0:14:31.

mb3.what: Ifukube's driving flight music pulses as Mechagodzilla flies out over the hills to meet Godzilla in their first battle, 0:34:44.

mb4.what: Ifukube's G-Force march plays as the Garuda is readied in its hangar for launch, 1:09:26.

mb5.what: Ifukube's solemn rising theme plays as Fire Rodan's dying glow flows into Godzilla before the climax, 1:33:46.

mb6.what: Ifukube's full Godzilla theme plays as Godzilla wades through the night sea toward Makuhari for the final battle, 1:18:28.
